mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for FEDFUNDS < 0.5% remains below 0.03, or 20-day forward returns in these periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5% (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), it signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly high housing starts (HOUST > 650) and strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 130000) signal robust consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 650 and PAYEMS > 130000.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, GDP growth above 13400 (GDPC1 > 13400) indicates sustained economic momentum that supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 13400.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95 (INDPRO < 95) indicates weakening economic activity, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 95.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment above 5.0% (UNRATE > 5.0%) reflects labor market weakness and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and moderate CPI index (CPIAUCSL < 230) signal stable inflation and accommodative policy, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and CPIAUCSL < 230.

mechanism_narrative: Robust employment growth above 130000 (PAYEMS > 130000) indicates strong labor markets and rising consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 130000.
